Class ClientManager

java.lang.Object
Business.ClientManager
public class ClientManager extends Object
Business-layer facade for client authentication and registration. Delegates to a ClientDAO implementation and translates PersistenceException into the appropriate BusinessException subclass.

      Registers a new IndividualClient with an auto-incremented numeric ID derived from the highest existing numeric client ID.
